headline: Nigerian Naira Recovers Following Central Bank Interventions
summary: The naira appreciated against the US dollar in the official foreign exchange market, recovering N14.74 as foreign reserves reached $55.26 billion and the central bank intervened.
why: Central bank foreign exchange interventions and reserve levels directly influence currency stability and import costs in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: USD/NGN
impacts.why: Central bank interventions and robust foreign reserves help strengthen the local currency against the dollar in official trading.
